Missense variants such as Arg60Cys, Arg60Leu, Arg181Gln, Arg183Pro, Ser211Trp, Val340Met and Phe341Leu alter Galpha11 structure. Arg181Gln and Phe341Leu are predicted to destabilize the GTP hydrolysis transition state and so prolong the active GTP-bound state.
